manifest.name: dsh-agent-theater
manifest.description: Agent Theater — a DSH conversation view that turns a session into a character stage: scene-driven pet, comic bubbles, a completion report and real deliverables.

bundle.text:
# Agent Theater bundle patch.
# One Host row exists only so the package can be installed as a bundle; the
# theater itself is a Client half (./client) registered into conversation.view.
- insert:
    - id: agent-theater
      name: 'dsh-agent-theater'
      config: {}

readme.text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[](https://github.com/lim1202/dsh-agent-theater/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

Turns a DSH session into a **character stage**: a `conversation.view` called **Theater** sits beside Chat and Trajectory. The character reacts to real tool events, your message becomes a short comic bubble, the agent's output becomes a subtitle, and when a turn ends she presents the result and its deliverables on stage.

- No fork, no changes to DSH core; only public extension points (`conversation.view` slot, standard Client hooks, the `ctx.sidebarRight` / `ctx.uiConversation` services).
- **No extra model calls**: every line comes from the Chat data the Conversation layer already assembled.
- Chat and Trajectory stay intact and are one click away; uninstalling the plugin restores the default UI.

- **One stage, not a chat list**: the whole view is the stage — scene label, a large character (props, halo, badge), and a bottom deck for comic bubbles, subtitles and a shared status bar.
- **Four scenes** driven by real session state: Idle · Working (live tool + operation count + timer) · Completion (report card) · Attention (request card).
- **Completion report**: the turn's real final answer (Markdown, collapsed by default, expandable, copyable) + real statistics (read/search/run/edit, elapsed time) + **delivered files, edited files and attachments**; `present` descriptions render under the file name, a file row opens in the right Sidebar and a thumbnail opens an in-stage lightbox.
- **Attention**: shows the real approval reason or the real question and options (read-only). Acting still happens in the native approval UI / composer — the plugin never approves for you.
- **Codex Pet**: import a `pet.json` + `spritesheet.webp` folder and the character becomes a frame-by-frame sprite animation; without a Pet it uses a built-in placeholder character.
- **Restrained**: tool calls never enter the narrative; they only show up in the status bar and props. There is no history list — the

| Working (with an imported Pet) | Completion |
| --- | --- |
|  |  |

| Attention | No Pet (built-in placeholder) |
| --- | --- |
|  |  |

> The character in these screenshots is a **locally imported Codex Pet**; no character art ships with this repository. Without a Pet the built-in placeholder is used.

Requires DSH Desktop **0.2.1-rc.x** (tested on `0.2.1-rc.5`; the package declares `engines.dsh`). After installing, **refresh the page once** (Client modules are read at page load) and the view switcher above the conversation will offer **Theater**.

In DSH's **Plugins** page choose install and paste:

```
github:lim1202/dsh-agent-theater
```

Or from the command line (install the app's command-line tool first; the `desktop` profile requires an initialized profile and the app fully quit):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:lim1202/dsh-agent-theater
```

readme.section: Option B: release tarball or a local directory
readme.text: ```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/lim1202/dsh-agent-theater/releases/download/v0.1.1/dsh-agent-theater-0.1.1.tgz

readme.section: or a directory you cloned/copied locally
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-agent-theater
```

The Plugins page also accepts a local directory path.

readme.section: Option C: a Discover index source
readme.text:
DSH 0.2.1+ can read plugin-market indexes (JSON, format 1) under **Plugins → Discover → Index sources**. This repository ships one; add this URL to search and install it from Discover:

```
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/lim1202/dsh-agent-theater@v0.1.1/index.json
```

Fallback (not a CDN; on some networks it can exceed the 15-second budget DSH gives an index source):

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lim1202/dsh-agent-theater/v0.1.1/index.json
```

1. Refresh the page, then use the view switcher above the conversation → **Theater**.
2. Import a Codex Pet if you want one (see below); it is optional.
3. To turn it off, disable the bundle on the Plugins page (you are back to plain Chat immediately); see uninstall at the end.

Click **Select Pet assets** in the Theater toolbar → the native folder picker → choose a folder containing `pet.json`. The assets are **copied** into a dedicated directory; the source folder stays read-only and untouched:

```
$DSH_HOME/agent-theater/            # defaults to ~/.dsh/agent-theater
├── config.json                     # {"active": "laffey-ii"}
└── pets/<id>/
    ├── pet.json                    # normalized manifest written on import

`pet.json` fields: `id`, `displayName`, `description`, `spriteVersionNumber` (only `2` is accepted) and `spritesheetPath` (a relative path inside the Pet folder; `..` and absolute paths are rejected). Sheets may be up to 24MB, webp/png/jpeg/avif, and their pixel size must be a multiple of the frame grid.

readme.section: Grid and row mapping (calibrated against laffey-ii v2)
readme.text: One frame is `192x208`, 8 columns × 11 rows = `1536x2288` (frames per row are determined from transparent pixels and start at column 0):

readme.section: Grid and row mapping (calibrated against laffey-ii v2)
readme.text:
| Row | Frames | Content | Used for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | 7 | Idle: breathing, blinking | `idle` |
| 4 | 5 | Crouch, jump, land | `success` |
| 5 | 8 | Head down, sigh | `error` |
| 6 | 6 | Arms crossed, waiting | `waiting` |
| 7 | 6 | Quick busy fidget | `working` |
| 8 | 6 | Hands folded, thinking | `thinking` / `research` |
| 1/2/3/9/10 | — | Run left/right, wave, turn | Reserved, unused |

readme.section: Grid and row mapping (calibrated against laffey-ii v2)
readme.text: Without an imported Pet the built-in placeholder from `src/art.js` (SVG + CSS animation) is used, with identical scenes and bubble behaviour.

| Scene | Stage | Bottom status bar |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Idle | Character rests, occasionally a line | `● Idle` |
| Working | Character acts + prop, live tool and timer | `● Working… · run node --test · 3 ops · 00:42` |
| Completion | Character + report card | `● Done · 2 files · 1 attachment` |
| Attention | Character + request card | `● Waiting for you · handle it below` |
Your latest message appears as a comic bubble (fades after 9s); the agent's live output shows as a subtitle; only one text beat is kept at a time — earlier history is in Chat.

- Answer: the turn's last real reply, Markdown-rendered, collapsed by default (~5 lines + fade), **Expand all** scrolls inside the card, **Copy result** copies it verbatim.
- Statistics: real tool-category counts and wall-clock duration; agent claims are **never parsed or paraphrased**.
- Deliverables: **Delivered** (files sent by `present`), **Edited files** (successful `write` / `edit` / mutating `str_replace_editor`, deduplicated, failures excluded) and **Attachments** (the turn's real image references).
  - A `present` `description` renders under the file name.
  - A file row opens in the right Sidebar (`dsh-resource://file/session/<sid>/<path>`); a thumbnail opens an in-stage lightbox.
  - Both degrade quietly when the services are unavailable: nothing is faked and no extra Host requests are made.
- The scene lasts until the next turn or until you press `×`; afterwards the stage returns to idle and the footer keeps the turn's deliverable counts.

The request card shows the real type (waiting for approval / waiting for your answer), `tool · reason`, and for questions the real prompts and options (read-only). The plugin **never renders its own approval buttons** and never auto-approves — you always act in the native composer / approval UI.

- Read-only session data: no requests, no writes to the session, no injected messages.
- Tool calls never enter the narrative; they appear only in the status bar, props and completion statistics.
- No rewriting of other plugins, no DOM reads, no covering the native composer or approval controls.
- Character lines are original text shipped with the plugin (zh/en); they are not agent output and are never written to the session log.
- Animations respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

- Built and tested against DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` (macOS; CI runs Ubuntu + macOS). Public interfaces used:
  - View registration: `ctx.slots.inject('conversation.view', () => ctx.slots.register({ name, id, order, label, locale }, Component))`
  - Data: slot props `useChat` (`{order, nodes}`), `useSessionStatus` (`running` / `pendingInteraction`), `openView('chat', focus)`
  - Deliverables: `ctx.sidebarRight.openResource`, `ctx.uiConversation.imageUrl` / `peekImageUrl`
  - Pet store: Host routes authenticated through `ctx.connection.admit`, plus `uiWorkspace.pickDirectory`
  - Text: `ctx.locale.register/bind`; styling uses theme tokens only (`--dsw-alias-*`)
- DSH is still in rc: slot and service signatures may change. If the view is blank after a DSH upgrade, report the browser console line `slot entry crashed in 'conversation.view'` in an issue.

No third-party dependencies (Node 20+):

```bash
node build.mjs              # rebuild client.js from src/*.js
node build.mjs --check      # verify the artifact is current
node --test test/*.test.mjs # unit tests (130)
node tools/scene-preview.mjs --help   # offline scene screenshots (needs a local Chrome)

- Client half (`src/*.js`): run `node build.mjs`, then refresh the page.
- Host half (`index.js`): the Loader does not hot-reload Host plugins; remove and reinstall the bundle on the Plugins page, or restart DSH.

- Remove the bundle on the Plugins page, or `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-agent-theater`.
- Pet assets live separately; deleting this directory removes them completely (the original Pet folder is untouched): `rm -rf ~/.dsh/agent-theater`.

- Without a Pet the character is an SVG + CSS placeholder; with one it is a frame-by-frame sprite animation (not Live2D).
- Only the latest text beat is visible on stage; earlier conversation lives in Chat / Trajectory (by design).
- Attachments list image references only; non-image attachments (PDF, code files, …) are not listed in the report yet.
- Markdown is a practical subset: no tables, images, task lists or inline HTML, and no syntax highlighting.
- Props map from tool names (`theaterPoseForTool`); unknown tools fall back to the generic working pose.
- Very narrow windows (<520px) squeeze the character and the cards; there is no "character only" fallback yet.
- The sprite sheet is downloaded whole on first paint and reused through ETag 304; rows are not fetched separately.
- The Host side only stores and validates assets; it never decodes images — the browser measures the grid.

- [MIT](LICENSE).
- Unofficial plugin, not affiliated with DeepSeek; DSH itself and any Codex Pet art remain the property of their respective owners.
- This repository contains no character art; the Pet in the screenshots was imported locally by the author. Check the licence of third-party character art before using it.

[](https://github.com/lim1202/dsh-agent-theater/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

把 DSH 的会话变成一座**角色舞台**：在 Chat、Trajectory 之外新增一个 `conversation.view` 视图 **剧场 / Theater**。角色随真实工具事件行动，你的话变成短暂的漫画气泡，Agent 的输出变成字幕，一轮结束时角色把成果与交付物摆在舞台上。

- 不 fork、不修改 DSH 核心；只用官方公开扩展点（`conversation.view` slot、Client 标准 hooks、`ctx.sidebarRight` / `ctx.uiConversation` 服务）。
- **不调用额外模型**：所有文字都来自 Conversation 层已经组装好的 Chat 数据。
- 原始 Chat 与 Trajectory 完全保留，随时切回；卸载插件即恢复原样。

- **一个舞台，不是聊天列表**：整个视图就是舞台 —— 场景标签、放大的角色（含道具、光晕、徽标）、底部演出层（漫画气泡 / 字幕 / 统一状态条）。
- **四个场景**由真实会话状态驱动：待机 · 工作中（实时工具 + 操作数 + 计时）· 完成（汇报卡）· 需要你（请求卡）。
- **完成汇报**：该轮真实回复（Markdown、默认折叠可展开、可复制）+ 真实统计（读取/搜索/运行/修改、耗时）+ **交付成果 / 已编辑文件 / 附件**，文件名下一行显示 `present` 附带的说明，点文件在右侧栏打开、点缩略图看大图。
- **需要你处理**：显示真实审批原因或真实问题与选项（只读），操作仍走原生审批 / 输入区，插件绝不代替你批准。
- **Codex Pet**：导入 `pet.json` + `spritesheet.webp` 即换成逐帧精灵动画；未导入时使用内置占位角色。
- **克制**：工具调用不进叙事，只在状态条与道具上体现；不显示历史列表，完整原文回 Chat 看。

| 工作中（已导入 Pet） | 完成 |
| --- | --- |
|  |  |

| 需要你处理 | 无 Pet（内置占位角色） |
| --- | --- |
|  |  |

> 截图里的角色来自**本地导入的 Codex Pet**，不随仓库分发；没有 Pet 时使用内置占位角色。
要求：DSH Desktop **0.2.1-rc.x**（实测 `0.2.1-rc.5`，包内已声明 `engines.dsh`）。安装后**刷新一次页面**（Client 模块只在页面加载时读取），会话上方的视图切换里会出现 **剧场**。

readme.section: 方式 A：从 GitHub 安装（推荐）
readme.text:
在 DSH 的 **Plugins** 页面选择安装，输入：

```
github:lim1202/dsh-agent-theater
```

或使用命令行（需先在应用里安装命令行工具；`desktop` profile 要求应用已初始化并完全退出）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:lim1202/dsh-agent-theater
```

readme.section: 方式 B：发布包 / 本地目录
readme.text: ```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/lim1202/dsh-agent-theater/releases/download/v0.1.1/dsh-agent-theater-0.1.1.tgz

readme.section: 或已克隆/拷贝到本地的目录
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-agent-theater
```

GUI 的插件页同样接受本地目录路径。

DSH 0.2.1+ 的 **Plugins → Discover → Index sources** 可以添加插件市场索引（JSON，格式 1）。本仓库自带一份，添加这个地址即可在 Discover 里搜索并安装：

```
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/lim1202/dsh-agent-theater@v0.1.1/index.json
```

备用地址（不是 CDN，个别网络下可能超出 DSH 给索引源的 15 秒时限）：

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lim1202/dsh-agent-theater/v0.1.1/index.json
```

1. 刷新页面，点会话上方的视图切换 → **剧场**。
2. 想用 Codex Pet 就导入一个（见下）；不导入也能用。
3. 关闭：Plugins 页面关闭该 bundle（立即回到普通 Chat）；卸载见文末。

剧场工具条上的「选择 Pet 资源」→ 原生文件夹选择框 → 选包含 `pet.json` 的文件夹。资源会被**复制**到独立目录，源文件夹只读、不受影响：

```
$DSH_HOME/agent-theater/            # 默认 ~/.dsh/agent-theater
├── config.json                     # {"active": "laffey-ii"}
└── pets/<id>/
    ├── pet.json                    # 导入时规范化后的清单

`pet.json` 字段：`id`、`displayName`、`description`、`spriteVersionNumber`（只接受 `2`）、`spritesheetPath`（pet 目录内的相对路径，禁止 `..` 与绝对路径）。精灵图 ≤ 24MB，webp/png/jpeg/avif，像素尺寸必须是帧网格整数倍。

readme.section: 网格与行映射（以 laffey-ii v2 实测校准）
readme.text:
`192x208` 一帧、8 列 × 11 行 = `1536x2288`（每行帧数由透明像素判定，从第 0 列连续排列）：

| 行 | 帧数 | 内容 | 用于 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | 7 | 待机：呼吸、眨眼 | `idle` |
| 4 | 5 | 起跳、腾空、落地 | `success` |
| 5 | 8 | 垂头叹气 | `error` |
| 6 | 6 | 抱臂等待 | `waiting` |
| 7 | 6 | 快速小动作（busy fidget） | `working` |
| 8 | 6 | 双手交叠、歪头思考 | `thinking` / `research` |
| 1/2/3/9/10 | — | 左右跑、挥手、转身 | 备用，未使用 |

未导入 Pet 时回退到 `src/art.js` 的内置占位角色（SVG + CSS 动画），场景与气泡行为完全一致。

| 场景 | 舞台 | 底部状态条 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 待机 | 角色待机，偶尔一句台词 | `● 待机中` |
| 工作中 | 角色做对应动作 + 道具，实时工具与计时 | `● 执行中… · 运行 node --test · 3 个操作 · 00:42` |
| 完成 | 角色 + 汇报卡 | `● 已完成 · 2 个文件 · 1 张附件` |
| 需要你 | 角色 + 请求卡 | `● 等待你处理 · 在下方输入区处理` |

你的最新一句话以漫画气泡出现（9 秒后淡出）；Agent 正在输出的内容作为字幕显示；任何时刻只保留一条文本节拍，历史回 Chat 看。

- 回答：该轮最后一条真实回复原文，Markdown 渲染，默认折叠（约 5 行 + 渐隐），「展开全部」在卡片内滚动，「复制结果」原样复制。
- 统计：真实工具分类计数与墙钟耗时；**不解析、不转述** Agent 自述的结论。
- 交付物：`交付成果`（`present` 送出的文件）、`已编辑文件`（成功的 `write` / `edit` / 可变 `str_replace_editor`，去重、失败不计）、`附件`（本轮真实图片引用）。
  - `present` 的 `description` 显示在文件名下一行。
  - 点文件 → 右侧栏打开（`dsh-resource://file/session/<sid>/<path>`）；点缩略图 → 舞台内灯箱。
  - 服务不可用时安静降级，不伪造、不额外请求。
- 场景持续到下一轮或点 `×` 收起；收起后回到待机，底部仍保留本轮产出计数。
请求卡显示真实类型（等待审批 / 等待你的回答）、`工具 · 原因`，提问类列出真实问题与选项（只读）。插件**不渲染自己的批准按钮**，也不会自动批准——操作始终在原生输入区 / 审批 UI 里完成。

- 只读会话数据：不发请求、不写会话、不注入消息。
- 工具调用不进叙事，只在状态条 / 道具 / 汇报统计中体现。
- 不改写其他插件，不读 DOM，不覆盖原生输入框与审批控件。
- 角色台词是插件自带的原创文案（中/英），不是 Agent 输出，也不会写进会话日志。
- 动效遵循 `prefers-reduced-motion`。

- 构建与实测：DSH `0.2.1-rc.5`（macOS）。依赖的公开接口：
  - 视图注册：`ctx.slots.inject('conversation.view', () => ctx.slots.register({ name, id, order, label, locale }, Component))`
  - 数据：slot props 的 `useChat`（`{order, nodes}`）、`useSessionStatus`（`running` / `pendingInteraction`）、`openView('chat', focus)`
  - 交付物：`ctx.sidebarRight.openResource`、`ctx.uiConversation.imageUrl` / `peekImageUrl`
  - Pet 存储：Host 路由 + `ctx.connection.admit` 鉴权、`uiWorkspace.pickDirectory`
  - 文案：`ctx.locale.register/bind`；样式只用主题 token `--dsw-alias-*`
- DSH 仍处于 rc 阶段，slot / 服务签名可能变化；升级 DSH 后若视图空白，把浏览器 console 的 `slot entry crashed in 'conversation.view'` 发到 issue。

无需第三方依赖（Node 20+）：

```bash
node build.mjs            # 生成 client.js（由 src/*.js 拼接）
node build.mjs --check    # 校验产物未过期
node --test test/*.test.mjs  # 单元测试（130 项）
node tools/scene-preview.mjs --help   # 离线场景截图工具（需本地 Chrome）

- 改 Client half（`src/*.js`）：`node build.mjs` 后刷新页面。
- 改 Host half（`index.js`）：Loader 不热重载 Host 插件，需在 Plugins 页面移除再安装，或重启 DSH。

- Plugins 页面移除该 bundle，或 `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-agent-theater`。
- 角色资源独立存放，删除即彻底清除（不影响原始 Pet 文件夹）：`rm -rf ~/.dsh/agent-theater`。

- 未导入 Pet 时是 SVG + CSS 占位角色；导入后是逐帧精灵动画（非 Live2D）。
- 舞台上只看得到最新一条文本节拍；更早对话到 Chat / Trajectory 查看（有意为之）。
- 附件只列图片引用；非图片附件（PDF、代码文件等）暂不在汇报卡列出。
- Markdown 是实用子集：不支持表格、图片、任务列表与内联 HTML，也不做语法高亮。
- 动作行按工具名映射（`theaterPoseForTool`），新工具默认「搬砖」动作。
- 极窄窗口（<520px）角色与卡片会纵向挤压，尚未做"仅角色"降级。
- 精灵图首屏整张下载，后续靠 ETag 304 复用缓存；未做按行/分块加载。
- Host 端只做资源存取与校验，不解析图片；网格尺寸由浏览器实测。

- [MIT](LICENSE)。
- 非官方插件，与 DeepSeek 无关；DSH 本体与 Codex Pet 素材版权归各自所有者。
- 仓库不含任何角色美术资源；截图中的角色是作者本地导入的示例 Pet。使用第三方角色美术前请自行确认授权。
